phrases.text: Alif-Lãm-Mĩm
The Romans have been defeated
in a nearby land.
Yet following their defeat, they will triumph
within three to nine years.
The ˹whole˺ matter rests with Allah before and after ˹victory˺.
And on that day the believers will rejoice
at the victory willed by Allah.
He gives victory to whoever He wills.
For He is the Almighty, Most Merciful
˹This is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in His promise.
phrases.head:
The explanation of the statement of the Exalted: وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَعْلَمُونَ (6)
(As a promise of Allah; Allah does not break His promise, but most people do not know. (30:6))

phrases.text: But most people do not know
They ˹only˺ know the worldly affairs of this life,
but are ˹totally˺ oblivious to the Hereafter
Have they not reflected upon their own being?
Allah only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term.
phrases.ar: مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا

phrases.text: Yet most people are truly in denial of the meeting with their Lord
Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them?
They were far superior in might;
they cultivated the land and developed it more than these ˹Meccans˺ ever have.
Their messengers came to them with clear proofs.
Allah would have never wronged them,
but it was they who wronged themselves
Then most evil was the end of the evildoers for denying and mocking the signs of Allah
It is Allah Who originates the creation,
and will resurrect it.
And then to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned
On the Day the Hour will arrive, the wicked will be dumbstruck
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: And on the Day when the Hour comes, the criminals shall be struck dumb in despair (30:12).

phrases.text: There will be no intercessors for them from among their associate-gods,
and they will ˹totally˺ deny their associate-gods
And on the Day the Hour will arrive, the people will then be split ˹into two groups˺
phrases.head:
The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ (14)
(And on the Day when the Hour arrives, on that Day they will be separated from one another. (30:14))

phrases.text: As for those who believed and did good, they will be rejoicing in a Garden
And as for those who disbelieved,
and denied Our signs and the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, they will be confined in punishment
So glorify Allah in the evening and in the morning
phrases.ar: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, the Exalted: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ (17) ("So glorify Allah when you enter the evening and when you enter the morning.")

phrases.text: all praise is for Him in the heavens and the earth
as well as in the afternoon,
and at noon
He brings forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living.
phrases.ar: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ

phrases.text: And He gives life to the earth after its death.
And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺
One of His signs is that He created you from dust,
phrases.head:
The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُونَ (30:20)
(And among His signs is that He created you from dust; and behold, thereafter you are humans who spread about.)

phrases.text: then
behold!
you are human beings spreading over ˹the earth˺
And one of His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves so that you may find comfort in them.
And He has placed between you compassion and mercy.
Surely in this are signs for people who reflect
And one of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth,
and the diversity of your languages and colours.
Surely in this are signs for those of ˹sound˺ knowledge
And one of His signs is your sleep by night and by day ˹for rest˺ as well as your seeking His bounty ˹in both˺.
Surely in this are signs for people who listen
And one of His signs is that He shows you lightning, inspiring ˹you with˺ hope and fear.
And He sends down rain from the sky, reviving the earth after its death.
Surely in this are signs for people who understand
And one of His signs is that the heavens and the earth persist by His command.
Then when He calls you out of the earth just once, you will instantly come forth
phrases.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِنَ الأرْضِ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ

phrases.text: And to Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth
phrases.ar: وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ
phrases.head:
The discourse on the explanation of His statement, the Exalted: وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ (30:26)
(And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and on the earth; all are obedient to Him.)

phrases.text: all are subject to His Will
And He is the One Who originates the creation then will resurrect it
which is even easier for Him.
To Him belong the finest attributes in the heavens and the earth.
And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
He sets forth for you an example ˹drawn˺ from your own lives:
would you allow some of those ˹bondspeople˺ in your possession to be your equal partners in whatever ˹wealth˺ We have provided you, keeping them in mind as you are mindful of your peers?
This is how We make the signs clear for people who understand
In fact, the wrongdoers merely follow their desires with no knowledge.
phrases.ar: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَنْ يَهْدِي مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ

phrases.text: Who then can guide those Allah has left to stray?
They will have no helpers
So be steadfast in faith in all uprightness ˹O Prophet˺
the natural Way of Allah which He has instilled in ˹all˺ people.
Let there be no change in this creation of Allah.
That is the Straight Way,
but most people do not know
˹O believers!˺ Always turn to Him ˹in repentance˺, be mindful of Him,
and establish prayers.
And do not be polytheists
˹like˺ those who have divided their faith and split into sects, each rejoicing in what they have
phrases.ar: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا

phrases.text: When people are touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺.
But as soon as He gives them a taste of His mercy, a group of them associates ˹others˺ with their Lord ˹in worship˺
becoming ungrateful for whatever ˹favours˺ We have given them.
phrases.head:
The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ (30:34)
(So that they are ungrateful for what We have given them. So enjoy yourselves; you will soon come to know.)

phrases.text: So enjoy yourselves, for soon you will know
Or have We sent down to them an authority which attests to what they associate ˹with Him˺
phrases.ar: أَمْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ

phrases.text: If We give people a taste of mercy, they become prideful ˹because˺ of it.
phrases.ar: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ

phrases.text: But if they are afflicted with an evil for what their hands have done, they instantly fall into despair
Have they not seen that Allah gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills?
Surely in this are signs for people who believe
So give your close relatives their due,
as well as the poor and the ˹needy˺ traveller.
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: So give the kinsman his due, and the needy and the traveller; that is better for those who desire the Face of Allah, and it is they who are the successful (38).

phrases.text: That is best for those who seek the pleasure of Allah,
and it is they who will be successful
Whatever loans you give, ˹only˺ seeking interest at the expense of people’s wealth will not increase with Allah.
But whatever charity you give, ˹only˺ seeking the pleasure of Allah
it is they whose reward will be multiplied
It is Allah Who created you,
then gives you provisions,
then will cause you to die,
and then will bring you back to life.
Can any of your associate-gods do any of this?
Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate with Him ˹in worship˺
Corruption has spread on land and sea as a result of what people’s hands have done,
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: Corruption has appeared on the land and on the sea because of what the hands of men have earned, that He may make them taste a part of what they have done, that perhaps they may return (41).

phrases.text: so that Allah may cause them to taste ˹the consequences of˺ some of their deeds and perhaps they might return ˹to the Right Path˺
Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Travel throughout the land and see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before ˹you˺
phrases.ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ

phrases.text: most of them were polytheists.”
So be steadfast in the Upright Faith ˹O Prophet˺,
before the coming of a Day from Allah that cannot be averted.
phrases.ar: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

phrases.text: On that Day the people will be divided
phrases.ar: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ

phrases.text: those who disbelieved will bear ˹the burden of˺ their own disbelief;
and those who did good will have prepared for themselves ˹eternal homes˺
so that He may ˹generously˺ reward those who believe and do good, out of His grace.
He truly does not like the disbelievers
And one of His signs is that He sends the winds, ushering in good news ˹of rain˺ so that He may give you a taste of His mercy,
and that ships may sail by His command,
and that you may seek His bounty,
and perhaps you will be grateful
Indeed, We sent before you ˹O Prophet˺ messengers, each to their own people,
and they came to them with clear proofs.
Then We inflicted punishment upon those who persisted in wickedness.
For it is Our duty to help the believers
It is Allah Who sends the winds,
phrases.ar: اللَّهُ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا

phrases.text: which then stir up ˹vapour, forming˺ clouds,
which He then spreads out in the sky or piles up into masses as He wills, from which you see rain come forth.
Then as soon as He causes it to fall on whoever He wills of His servants, they rejoice
although they had utterly lost hope just before it was sent down to them
phrases.ar: وَإِنْ كَانُوا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
phrases.head:
The explanation of the words of the Exalted: وَإِنْ كَانُوا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ (49)
("Although they, before it was sent down upon them — before that — were in despair") (30:49).

phrases.text: See then the impact of Allah’s mercy:
how He gives life to the earth after its death!
Surely That ˹same God˺ can raise the dead.
For He is Most Capable of everything
Then if We send a ˹harsh˺ wind which they see withering ˹their˺ crops, they will definitely deny ˹old favours˺ right after
phrases.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَظَلُّوا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ

phrases.text: So you ˹O Prophet˺ certainly cannot make the dead hear ˹the truth˺.
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: Truly, you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away, retreating (30:52).

phrases.text: Nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs and walk away
Nor can you lead the blind out of their misguidance.
You can make none hear ˹the truth˺ except those who believe in Our revelations, ˹fully˺ submitting ˹to Allah˺
It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness,
phrases.ar: ثُم جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً

phrases.text: then developed ˹your˺ weakness into strength,
then developed ˹your˺ strength into weakness and old age.
He creates whatever He wills.
For He is the All-Knowing, Most Capable
And on the Day the Hour will arrive, the wicked will swear that they did not stay ˹in this world˺ more than an hour.
In this way they were always deluded ˹in the world˺
But those gifted with knowledge and faith will say ˹to them˺, “You did actually stay
as destined by Allah
until the Day of Resurrection.
So here is the Day of Resurrection ˹which you denied˺!
But you did not know ˹it was true˺.”
So on that Day the wrongdoers’ excuses will not benefit them,
nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺
We have certainly set forth every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people in this Quran.
And no matter what sign you bring to them ˹O Prophet˺, the disbelievers will definitely say ˹to the believers˺, “You are only a people of falsehood.”
phrases.ar: لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ

phrases.text: This is how Allah seals the hearts of those unwilling to know ˹the truth˺
phrases.head:
The explanation of the statement of the Exalted: كَذَلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لا يَعْلَمُونَ (30:59)
("Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know" (30:59)).

phrases.text: So be patient, for the promise of Allah certainly is true.
phrases.ar: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لا يُوقِنُونَ
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لا يُوقِنُونَ ("So be patient; verily, the promise of Allah is true, and let not those who are without certainty cause you to waver") (30:60).

phrases.text: And do not be disturbed by those who have no sure faith
